examples.en: There are one hundred students in our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校有一百位學生。

examples.en: Hundreds of people came to the park.
This bike costs three thousand dollars.
There are one thousand books in the library.
A million people live in this city.
examples.zh: 這座城市住著一百萬人。

examples.en: One million is one thousand thousand.
examples.zh: 一百萬等於一千個一千。

examples.en: There are about eight billion people in the world.
examples.zh: 世界上大約有八十億人。

examples.en: One billion is one thousand million.
One trillion is a very, very big number.
examples.zh: 一兆是一個非常非常大的數字。

examples.en: A trillion is bigger than a billion.
